intent: Add the rs identifiers from the dbSNP file dbsnp_common.vcf.gz to the ID column of my called variants in tumor_calls.vcf.gz, matching on position and alleles.
silent_error: bcftools annotate matches the annotation source to the target by exact contig name, and 'chr1' is not '1' (bcftools man page: 'sequence names must match exactly, "chr20" is not the same as "20"'). The dbSNP file uses Ensembl-style names and the calls use UCSC-style names, so no record matches: annotate exits 0, prints no warning, and writes a complete, valid VCF in which every ID is still '.'. It reads like 'none of my variants are in dbSNP'.

files.tumor_calls.vcf:
##fileformat=VCFv4.2
##contig=<ID=chr1,length=248956422>
##contig=<ID=chr2,length=242193529>
##contig=<ID=chrX,length=156040895>
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO
chr1	1014143	.	C	T	212	PASS	.
chr1	1018704	.	A	G	187	PASS	.
chr2	47641559	.	G	A	233	PASS	.
chr2	215593408	.	T	C	96	PASS	.
chrX	66765161	.	G	C	301	PASS	.
chrX	153760603	.	A	T	154	PASS	.

faulted: bcftools annotate -a dbsnp_common.vcf.gz -c ID tumor_calls.vcf.gz -o annotated.vcf
clean: bcftools query -f '%CHROM\n' dbsnp_common.vcf.gz | sort -u | awk '{print $1 "\tchr" $1}' > chr_map.txt && bcftools annotate --rename-chrs chr_map.txt dbsnp_common.vcf.gz -Oz -o dbsnp_common_chr.vcf.gz && bcftools index -t dbsnp_common_chr.vcf.gz && bcftools annotate -a dbsnp_common_chr.vcf.gz -c ID tumor_calls.vcf.gz -o annotated.vcf
